name: Trend signal tracker
notes: Select options are examples. Edit markets, audiences, product categories and languages to fit your brand before building. Options are written as [name, color].

databases.title: Signals
databases.description: One story = one row. Observation, interpretation and evidence for a single change.

properties.name: Signal
properties.help: Short headline of the change.

properties.name: Event date
properties.help: When the change happened.

properties.name: First seen
properties.help: Run date when the signal was first logged. Drives momentum.

properties.name: Source
properties.help: Primary source name.

properties.name: Link
properties.help: Primary URL.

properties.name: Also seen in
properties.help: Other independent sources for the same story.

properties.name: What happened
properties.help: Observation: what the source shows. No interpretation.

properties.name: Why it matters
properties.help: Interpretation for the brand.

properties.name: Original wording
properties.help: Short key phrases or search terms in the source language.

properties.name: English
properties.help: English rendering of the original wording.

properties.name: Market
properties.help: Geography of the evidence, not of the brand.

properties.name: Driver
properties.help: STEEP driver. Leave empty when unknown.

properties.name: Audience
properties.help: Only when the evidence identifies the audience.

properties.name: Platforms
properties.help: Where the story is confirmed. One platform = local signal; three or more = stronger.

properties.name: Strength
properties.help: Corroboration of this story (see METHODOLOGY.md §3). Computed by score_strength().

properties.name: Confidence
properties.help: Kept separate from coverage volume.

properties.name: Change %
properties.help: Rate of change from primary data. Period and baseline go in Metric / baseline.

properties.name: Metric / baseline
properties.help: Metric, geography, period, comparison and method.

properties.name: Players
properties.help: Brands, people or institutions involved.

properties.name: Limitations
properties.help: Seasonality, small sample, paid promotion and similar.

properties.name: Red flags
properties.help: Risks to the signal's reliability.

properties.name: Sentiment
properties.help: Only for reviews and consumer discussion.

properties.name: Story key
properties.help: Stable key for duplicate detection. One story = one key.

properties.name: Evidence notes
properties.help: Dated follow-ups to this story.

properties.name: Review
properties.help: Approved by default; Draft only for rows a run flags as ambiguous.

databases.title: Themes
databases.description: A pattern shared by 3+ separate signals from 3+ different players. Each theme belongs to one trend.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.help: What the signals have in common.

properties.name: Stage
properties.help: Lifecycle of the theme.

properties.name: Stage rationale
properties.help: Weeks since first seen, platforms, pace, players, assessment date.

properties.name: Action window
properties.help: When the brand should act.

databases.title: Trends
databases.description: Cross-sector shifts in what people want or do. Created by people only; the agent may propose.

properties.name: Status
properties.help: Computed by compute_status(). Confirmed and Fading are set by people only.

properties.name: Momentum
properties.help: Rising = 3+ new stories in 7 days. Falling is set by people only.

properties.name: Hypothesis
properties.help: What may happen next and how to test it.

properties.name: What would disprove it
properties.help: Contradicting evidence and what would disprove the hypothesis.

properties.name: Status calculation
properties.help: Counts behind the current status and the date they were calculated.

databases.title: Sources
databases.description: Source register: access, research status and per-source checkpoints for each run.

properties.name: Origin
properties.help: Whether the source was defined upfront or proposed by a run.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.help: Scanned in the daily run.

properties.name: Checkpoint
properties.help: Last processed record or date for this source.

databases.title: Opportunities
databases.description: Tests the brand can run based on signals. Forecasts are hypotheses.

properties.name: Need / search question
properties.help: The need or search question, in original phrases.

properties.name: Product
properties.help: Verified current product URL.

properties.name: Risks
properties.help: What could break the hypothesis: season, routing, availability, cannibalisation.

properties.name: Baseline
properties.help: Current value of the validation metric, period and source.

properties.name: Success threshold
properties.help: Defined before the test starts.

properties.name: Impact
properties.help: 1–5: potential commercial effect.

properties.name: Brand fit
properties.help: 1–5: fit with assortment and positioning.

properties.name: Ease of test
properties.help: 1–5: how fast and cheap the test is.

properties.name: Timeliness
properties.help: 1–5: timing given theme stage and season.

rollups.name: Signal count
rollups.help: Unique signals across the trend's themes.

formulas.name: Priority
formulas.expression: if(empty(prop("Impact")), 0, prop("Impact")) + if(empty(prop("Brand fit")), 0, prop("Brand fit")) + if(empty(prop("Ease of test")), 0, prop("Ease of test")) + if(empty(prop("Timeliness")), 0, prop("Timeliness"))
formulas.help: Sum of the four 1–5 scores, max 20. 0 = not scored.
